parameters.content:
## Weekly Business KPI Report
Every Monday morning, emails you a one-page report on last week: revenue, orders, average order, new leads, lead sources, best days and top customers — each compared with the week before.

### Setup
1. Make sure your sheet has a **Leads** tab (`Date`, `Source`) and a **Sales** tab (`Date`, `Amount`, `Customer Name`). See the CSV templates.
2. Fill in **Config** and pick your **Google Sheets** (2 nodes) and **SMTP** credentials.
3. Click **Activate**.

Full guide: README.md in this workflow's folder.
